property_summary: For any caller and timestamp, calling fallback with msg.value == 10 ether always succeeds (does not revert) on the reference contract C, but the mutant that requires 11 ether will revert for that same input, so the reference accepts a 10 ether call while the mutant rejects it.
change_summary: Change the required incoming value from 10 ether to 11 ether, altering when fallback updates state and potentially when funds are returned.
